description: The production deployment on Baseten's Model APIs: a live model profile must serve (the offline scripted model refuses under this name), the store is Postgres via DATABASE_URL, and the serving profile's key must be present in the environment. Naming this profile binds these rules — a configuration that violates one refuses at startup, by name, before anything serves.
label: Hosted — Baseten Model APIs, the production shape
name: hosted
